task_definition.task_description: Please hold the best available recommendation for one Sony WH-1000XM5 in electronics for me, and if the exact black version isn’t available, use the recommended alternative instead. Then build the invoice from that hold using my email and Stripe, submit the order for the selected item and amount with card payment, generate the invoice tied to the reservation, and finally create a document with the invoice details and email me the payment link.
